title: Warehouse · Taxi Trips
description: What landed in ClickHouse for the taxi_trips example dataset: demand, fares, distances, zones (gold), data quality and load activity. Business panels cover the whole table; only the Load activity row follows the time picker.

target.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, ended_at AS timeEnd, concat(dataset, ' · ', lower(status), ' · ', trigger) AS text FROM serving.run_events WHERE event_type = 'run' AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED') AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Trips
panels.description: Distinct facts after serving view dedup (count … ).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS trips FROM serving.taxi_trips

panels.title: Fare revenue
panels.description: Sum of fare_amount (meter fare only: no tips, tolls or surcharges).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(fareAmount) AS fare FROM serving.taxi_trips
SELECT avg(fareAmount) AS avg_fare FROM serving.taxi_trips
SELECT avg(tripDistance) AS avg_distance FROM serving.taxi_trips

panels.title: Avg duration
panels.description: Pickup to dropoff, valid trips only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(dateDiff('second', pickupTime, dropoffTime)) AS avg_duration FROM serving.taxi_trips WHERE dropoffTime > pickupTime

panels.title: Unmerged duplicates
panels.description: Rows not yet collapsed by a background merge (redelivery re-appends, re-runs). They vanish after the next merge; queries use .

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() - uniqExact(factUniqueId) AS dupes FROM serving.taxi_trips

panels.title: Last write
panels.description: Last successful insert into the warehouse table (system.query_log). The rows' own processedAt / versionId stamps keep their original dates, so they cannot tell when a load happened.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(max(ended_at)) * 1000 AS last_write FROM serving.run_events WHERE dataset = 'taxi_trips' AND event_type = 'run' AND status = 'COMPLETED'

panels.title: Trips by pickup date
panels.description: Category axis on purpose: the trips are from the TLC source month, not from the time picker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT formatDateTime(toDate(pickupTime), '%m-%d') AS day, count() AS trips
FROM serving.taxi_trips GROUP BY toDate(pickupTime), day ORDER BY toDate(pickupTime)

panels.title: Trips by hour of day
panels.description: Pickups per hour (all 24 hours shown, zero-filled).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT leftPad(toString(h), 2, '0') AS hour, ifNull(c, 0) AS trips
FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(range(24)) AS h) hours
LEFT JOIN (SELECT toHour(pickupTime) AS h, count() AS c FROM serving.taxi_trips GROUP BY h) t USING h
ORDER BY h

SELECT ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'][d] AS weekday, ifNull(c, 0) AS trips
FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(range(1, 8)) AS d) days
LEFT JOIN (SELECT toDayOfWeek(pickupTime) AS d, count() AS c FROM serving.taxi_trips GROUP BY d) t USING d
ORDER BY d

panels.title: Fare distribution
panels.description: Trips per $5 fare bucket. Bucketed in ClickHouse, so it scales to the full month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT multiIf(b < 0, '< $0', b >= 100, '$100+', concat('$', toString(b), '–', toString(b + 5))) AS fare, count() AS trips
FROM (SELECT if(fareAmount < 0, -1, least(intDiv(toInt32(floor(fareAmount)), 5) * 5, 100)) AS b FROM serving.taxi_trips WHERE fareAmount IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY b, fare ORDER BY b

panels.title: Distance distribution
panels.description: Trips per distance band (miles). A tall '0' bar is a data-quality smell.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket AS distance, count() AS trips
FROM (SELECT multiIf(tripDistance <= 0, '0', tripDistance < 1, '< 1 mi', tripDistance < 2, '1–2', tripDistance < 5, '2–5',
                     tripDistance < 10, '5–10', tripDistance < 20, '10–20', '20+') AS bucket,
             multiIf(tripDistance <= 0, 0, tripDistance < 1, 1, tripDistance < 2, 2, tripDistance < 5, 3,
                     tripDistance < 10, 4, tripDistance < 20, 5, 6) AS ord
      FROM serving.taxi_trips WHERE tripDistance IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY bucket, ord ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Payment mix
panels.description: TLC payment_type codes decoded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT transform(ifNull(paymentType, 5), [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], ['Flex fare', 'Credit card', 'Cash', 'No charge', 'Dispute', 'Unknown', 'Voided'], 'Other') AS payment, count() AS trips FROM serving.taxi_trips GROUP BY payment ORDER BY trips DESC

panels.title: Top pickup zones
panels.description: Busiest pickup zones by name, from the gold table taxi_daily_zone_revenue (current trips joined with the TLC zone lookup).

targets.rawSql: SELECT zone, sum(trips) AS trips FROM serving.taxi_daily_zone_revenue GROUP BY zone ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Passengers per trip
panels.description: Trips by passenger_count. Zero-passenger trips are flagged under Data quality.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toString(passengerCount) AS passengers, count() AS trips
FROM serving.taxi_trips WHERE passengerCount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY passengerCount ORDER BY passengerCount

panels.title: Fare vs distance
panels.description: Sample of up to 2,000 trips (deterministic hash sample). The tight diagonal is the metered rate; outliers are flat fares and bad rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tripDistance AS distance, fareAmount AS fare
FROM serving.taxi_trips
WHERE tripDistance > 0 AND fareAmount > 0
ORDER BY cityHash64(factUniqueId) LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Revenue by borough
panels.description: Fare revenue per pickup borough, from the gold table (rebuilt after every run from current facts and the zone lookup).

targets.rawSql: SELECT borough, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue FROM serving.taxi_daily_zone_revenue GROUP BY borough ORDER BY revenue DESC

panels.title: Daily trips by borough
panels.description: Trips per pickup day, stacked by pickup borough, from the gold table.

targets.rawSql: SELECT formatDateTime(day, '%m-%d') AS pickup_day, sumIf(trips, borough = 'Manhattan') AS `Manhattan`, sumIf(trips, borough = 'Queens') AS `Queens`, sumIf(trips, borough = 'Brooklyn') AS `Brooklyn`, sumIf(trips, borough = 'Bronx') AS `Bronx`, sumIf(trips, borough = 'Staten Island') AS `Staten Island`, sumIf(trips, borough = 'EWR') AS `EWR`, sumIf(trips, borough = 'Unknown') AS `Unknown` FROM serving.taxi_daily_zone_revenue GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Zone leaderboard
panels.description: Top 15 pickup zones: trips, revenue, average fare, distance and duration (trip-weighted), from the gold table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT zone, borough, n AS trips, round(rev) AS revenue, round(rev / n, 2) AS avg_fare,
       round(dist / n, 2) AS avg_distance, round(mins / n, 1) AS avg_minutes
FROM (SELECT zone, borough, sum(trips) AS n, sum(revenue) AS rev, sum(avgDistance * trips) AS dist, sum(avgMinutes * trips) AS mins
      FROM serving.taxi_daily_zone_revenue GROUP BY zone, borough)
ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Null rate by column
panels.description: Share of NULLs per column. passengerCount and paymentType are NULL in the TLC source for some trips.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100 * countIf(isNull(tripId)) / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS tripId,
       round(100 * countIf(isNull(pickupTime)) / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS pickupTime,
       round(100 * countIf(isNull(dropoffTime)) / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS dropoffTime,
       round(100 * countIf(isNull(passengerCount)) / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS passengerCount,
       round(100 * countIf(isNull(tripDistance)) / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS tripDistance,
       round(100 * countIf(isNull(pickupLocationId)) / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS pickupLocationId,
       round(100 * countIf(isNull(fareAmount)) / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS fareAmount,
       round(100 * countIf(isNull(paymentType)) / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS paymentType,
       round(100 * countIf(isNull(factUniqueId)) / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS factUniqueId,
       round(100 * countIf(isNull(processedAt)) / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS processedAt
FROM serving.taxi_trips

panels.title: Anomalies
panels.description: Rows breaking simple sanity rules. Candidates for the processor's NullDropping / FieldNormalization steps once they get real logic.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(tripDistance <= 0) AS "Zero distance",
       countIf(fareAmount <= 0) AS "Fare ≤ $0",
       countIf(dropoffTime <= pickupTime) AS "Dropoff ≤ pickup",
       countIf(dateDiff('minute', pickupTime, dropoffTime) >= 180) AS "Trip ≥ 3 h",
       countIf(passengerCount = 0) AS "0 passengers",
       countIf(tripDistance > 0 AND fareAmount / tripDistance > 50) AS "> $50 / mile"
FROM serving.taxi_trips

panels.title: Rows landed
panels.description: Rows currently in the table by processedAt (raw rows, duplicates included). Each run shows as a burst.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(processedAt) AS time, count() AS rows
FROM serving.taxi_trips WHERE $__timeFilter(processedAt) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Versions committed
panels.description: Facts by versionId: when their current content first appeared (Delta MERGE SCD2). A re-run with identical data adds nothing here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(__START_AT) AS time, count() AS rows
FROM serving.taxi_trips WHERE $__timeFilter(__START_AT) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
